maya: Heads up — noticed a p99 spike after the model onboarding merge (checkpoint v3.9 + tokenizer change). Looks like token boundaries shifted for multibyte UTF-8 and the batch scheduler is starving on certain shards. CI perf failed on staging too. @adrien @sam
ci-bot: perf-ci/staging pipeline: p50 +12ms, p95 +104ms, p99 +320ms vs baseline — thresholds exceeded. https://ci.redwood/builds/7832
adrien: can you paste the profiler output? which kernel is firing?
maya: profiler snippet: kernel_selector chose attn_v2 on long sequences; batch window collapsed from 12 -> 2 in the hot path. KV hit rate fell from 0.87 -> 0.21 after tokenmap change. logs: `kvcache.hit_rate=0.21 kvcache.evictions=420/s`
sam: that KV-hit drop explains the latency. tokenization change broke prefix alignment? did we change normalization or grapheme rules?
maya: yes — tokenizer now preserves NBSP and splits some ligatures differently. token ids shifted ~+1 for many multibyte tokens which misaligns prefix cache keys and kernel selection heuristics that rely on token-length estimates.
tomas: urgent mitigation: can we route traffic to the variant with the old token map? we still have v3.8 compatible variant.
adrien: create a 5% canary to v3.8 and monitor p99. also open a revert PR for the tokenizer change.
maya: opened PR #4210 to revert the tokenizer normalizer and started canary: `rb route set inference-prod --variant v3.8 --pct 5`
sam: for bisect — suspect commit abc123 in tokenizer repo. @liu can you run the tokenizer-diff tool on a representative corpus (en, ja, emoji-heavy prompts)?
liu: ran tokenizer-diff on en+ja+emoji corpora. Found widespread token id offsets; median shift 0.9 tokens/sentence, many early-prefix mismatches. gist: https://gist.github.com/liu/token-diff-176999
maya: creating a temporary runtime hotfix: avoid using token-id-based prefix cache for 200ms after node startup and fallback to raw byte-prefix-match for cache lookups. PR #4214 created with small perf guard.
renee: ops will throttle batch window to min_batch=4 on affected pools to reduce starvation while we iterate. ramping now.
ops-bot: rolling change applied: `set pool=gpu-prod-7 batch.window.min=4` — change in progress
adrien: plan of record: 1) revert tokenizer in the model-onboard PR, 2) if canary p99 still > baseline after 10m roll back more traffic / full rollback, 3) add token-map-stability regression to CI that checks KV prefix-hit delta on tokenization diffs. agree?
everyone: +1 :thumbsup:
maya: follow-ups: file ticket for `model-ci: token-map-stability check` (will include representative prompts + prefix-hash diff), add kvcache hit-rate alert to staging dashboard, and add a kernel-selector guard that re-evaluates heuristics when token-length distribution shifts > 10% post-onboard.
adrien: addendum — add a small unit in perf CI that runs the new tokenizer against the baseline token map and fails the onboard if KV hit delta > 0.15. This should catch similar regressions earlier.
maya: thanks all — will coordinate revert + runtime hotfix and post updates in this thread.
__note: Slack thread; messages are a single continuous string in chronological order. No title field per agents.md.
